content:
The following example shows an OpenSearch Service notiﬁcation event sent to Amazon
EventBridge. The notiﬁcation has a severity of Informational because the update is optional:
{
"version": "0",
"id": "01234567-0123-0123-0123-012345678901",
"detail-type": "Amazon OpenSearch Service Software Update Notification",
"source": "aws.es",
"account": "123456789012",
"time": "2016-11-01T13:12:22Z",
"region": "us-east-1",
"resources": ["arn:aws:es:us-east-1:123456789012:domain/test-domain"],
"detail": {
"event": "Service Software Update",
"status": "Available",
"severity": "Informational",
"description": "Service software update [R20200330-p1] available."
}
}
